<!-- pr-reviewer: ea93c853bec1b80e9423e499f66aaeaa03b01dd4 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. (The PR stays a draft on purpose.)

**What looks good**
- `assets.rs` can only add suites: it builds one text from the entry file and all declared module files. The old entry-file text is part of the new text. A flat suite whose `mod x;` file names an asset is now also selected.
- `catalog.rs` uses `suites::entry`. For the flat file the result is the same as before. A directory `example_catalog` is now found too.
- `plan.rs` `may_run_ignored` stays conservative. A directory suite gets no heavy step only when the module walk succeeds, no declared module file is missing, and no source text holds `ignore`, `include!` or `#[path`.
- Handled by the code:
  - Any source file with `#[ignore`, `ignore` in `#[cfg_attr(...)]`, or the word `ignore` in a macro call: true (plain text match on every file).
  - `include!` or `#[path` in any file: true.
  - An unreadable file, or a walk error (including cycle and depth limit): true.
  - A declared module whose file is absent: true (`sources_and_missing`; the counter is shared with the recursion, so a missing file in a nested module counts).
  - A nested `mod a { mod b; }` and a `mod x;` inside a child: the walk recurses (`suites.rs` `visit`).
  - A flat suite: unchanged rule (a `mod x;` line plans a step).
- The dropped step is right. `crates/motion/tests/rest_adaptive/` holds `main.rs` and `sim.rs`. Neither has `ignore`, `include!`, `#[path` or `cfg_attr`. The existing test `heavy_steps_skip_only_binaries_without_ignored_tests` still pins that each binary with `#[ignore` has its step.
- The decision file is present and says what was dropped (the flat-suite walk, #3706). Process rules are met: `Process change: yes`, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited, `Changelog: none`, `Refs #3186` (no closing keyword).

**Results** (locally, in a worktree; the PR head already contains main `2de071415`, so the trial merge is empty and the head is the merged tree)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask -- --test-threads=6` | unit: 302 passed, 0 failed. Integration: catalog 4, docs_images 4, example_line_endings 3, merge_ready_skill 3, post_merge_concurrency 2, post_merge_report 1, post_merge_stall 1, release_site_tests 3, review_artifacts 3, lane_verdict 0, merge_review 0. All ok. |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | 1 step (`xtask unit tests`) |
| `cargo xtask gate release --dry-run`, origin/main (`2de071415`) against the merged tree | 260 steps in the queue before, 259 after. Step names and commands diff: only `motion heavy: rest_adaptive` (and its `--test rest_adaptive --ignored` command line) is gone. No other step changed. |

**Heavy lanes:** the diff is `xtask/` and `docs/` only. The PR body names no lane run, and none was needed. The result is the same as the author's reading. I did not run `cargo xtask gate heavy`, as the coordinator limited this review to xtask.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `suites.rs` `modules()` reads only the first `mod` on a line, and only a `mod` at the start of a line. A line such as `mod a; mod b;` or `#[cfg(test)] mod b;` would hide `b` from the walk. If only `b` held an `ignore`, a directory suite would then get no heavy step. rustfmt puts these on separate lines, and no directory suite in the repository has such a line (only `rest_adaptive` is one). You can add a guard in #3706: count `mod` tokens in each source and compare with the module count.
2. `#[cfg_attr(..., path = "x.rs")]` is not read as a path attribute. The flat rule has the same limit.
3. No test pins `include!` or `#[path` in a child module, a nested `mod a { mod b; }`, or an unreadable module of a directory suite. The code handles each of them. A test for each would make the pin complete (can go in #3706).
4. `assets.rs`: a module walk error (unreadable file, cycle) now makes `suites_for` return `Err`, so asset selection refuses loudly. Before, `scan::read` gave empty text. This is the safe direction, and no suite is dropped.
5. `xtask/src/directory_tests.rs` is 403 lines (the PR adds 2 `#[path]` lines; the file was already over). The new test file `directory_selection_tests.rs` (67 lines) is added through `#[path]`. Noted, not a blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
